instruction: Cual es el retraso promedio de llegada en minutos de todos los vuelos?
output:
SELECT AVG(DR.ArrDelayMinutes) AS RetrasoPromedioLlegada
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R;

instruction: Muestrame los 10 vuelos con mayor retraso de llegada en minutos.
output:
SELECT TOP 10 V.ID_Vuelo, V.Flight_Number_Operating_Airline, DR.ArrDelayMinutes
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R
ORDER BY DR.ArrDelayMinutes DESC;

instruction: Cuantos vuelos tuvieron un retraso de llegada de 15 minutos o mas?
output:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS VuelosRetrasados15
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R
WHERE DR.ArrDel15 = 1;

instruction: Cual es el retraso de salida promedio en minutos?
output:
SELECT AVG(DR.DepDelayMinutes) AS RetrasoPromedioSalida
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R;

instruction: Suma total de minutos de retraso atribuibles al clima (WeatherDelay).
output:
SELECT SUM(DR.WeatherDelay) AS TotalWeatherDelay
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R;

instruction: Desglosa el total de minutos de retraso por cada causa (carrier, weather, NAS, security, late aircraft).
output:
SELECT
    SUM(DR.CarrierDelay)      AS CarrierDelay,
    SUM(DR.WeatherDelay)      AS WeatherDelay,
    SUM(DR.NASDelay)          AS NASDelay,
    SUM(DR.SecurityDelay)     AS SecurityDelay,
    SUM(DR.LateAircraftDelay) AS LateAircraftDelay
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R;

instruction: Que porcentaje de vuelos llego con 15 minutos o mas de retraso?
output:
SELECT
    CAST(SUM(CAST(DR.ArrDel15 AS INT)) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS PctRetrasados
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R;

instruction: Dame el retraso de llegada promedio para los vuelos del 2024.
output:
SELECT AVG(DR.ArrDelayMinutes) AS RetrasoPromedio
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R
WHERE YEAR(V.FlightDate) = 2024;

instruction: Cuantos vuelos tuvieron retraso por seguridad mayor a cero?
output:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS VuelosConSecurityDelay
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R
WHERE DR.SecurityDelay > 0;

instruction: Cual es el maximo retraso de llegada registrado en minutos?
output:
SELECT MAX(DR.ArrDelayMinutes) AS MaxRetrasoLlegada
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R;

instruction: Promedio de retraso de salida solo para vuelos que se retrasaron en la salida 15 min o mas.
output:
SELECT AVG(DR.DepDelayMinutes) AS PromRetrasoSalida
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R
WHERE DR.DepDel15 = 1;

instruction: Cuenta los vuelos por mes y su retraso promedio de llegada.
output:
SELECT MONTH(V.FlightDate) AS Mes, COUNT(*) AS NumVuelos, AVG(DR.ArrDelayMinutes) AS RetrasoProm
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R
GROUP BY MONTH(V.FlightDate)
ORDER BY Mes;

instruction: Cual es el retraso de llegada promedio comparado con el retraso de salida promedio?
output:
SELECT AVG(DR.ArrDelayMinutes) AS RetrasoLlegada, AVG(DR.DepDelayMinutes) AS RetrasoSalida
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R;

instruction: Lista los vuelos con retraso por aeronave tardia (LateAircraftDelay) mayor a 60 minutos.
output:
SELECT V.ID_Vuelo, V.Flight_Number_Operating_Airline, DR.LateAircraftDelay
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R
WHERE DR.LateAircraftDelay > 60
ORDER BY DR.LateAircraftDelay DESC;

instruction: Total de vuelos registrados con informacion de retrasos.
output:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS TotalVuelosConRetrasos
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R;

instruction: Cual fue el retraso de llegada promedio en el primer trimestre (meses 1 a 3)?
output:
SELECT AVG(DR.ArrDelayMinutes) AS RetrasoProm
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R
WHERE MONTH(V.FlightDate) BETWEEN 1 AND 3;

instruction: Dame la suma de NASDelay y el numero de vuelos afectados por NAS.
output:
SELECT SUM(DR.NASDelay) AS TotalNASDelay, SUM(CASE WHEN DR.NASDelay > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS VuelosAfectados
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R;

instruction: Muestra el ActualElapsedTime promedio de los vuelos con retraso de llegada de 15 min o mas.
output:
SELECT AVG(CR.ActualElapsedTime) AS TiempoRealPromedio
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R
WHERE DR.ArrDel15 = 1;

instruction: Cual es el retraso de llegada promedio agrupado por grupo de distancia (DistanceGroup)?
output:
SELECT RU.DistanceGroup, AVG(DR.ArrDelayMinutes) AS RetrasoProm
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R
JOIN PROGRAMACION P ON R.ID_Programacion = P.ID_Programacion
JOIN RUTA RU        ON P.RutaID          = RU.RutaID
GROUP BY RU.DistanceGroup
ORDER BY RU.DistanceGroup;

instruction: Las 5 rutas (por RutaID) con mayor retraso de llegada promedio.
output:
SELECT TOP 5 RU.RutaID, AVG(DR.ArrDelayMinutes) AS RetrasoProm
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R
JOIN PROGRAMACION P ON R.ID_Programacion = P.ID_Programacion
JOIN RUTA RU        ON P.RutaID          = RU.RutaID
GROUP BY RU.RutaID
ORDER BY RetrasoProm DESC;

instruction: Relacion entre distancia de la ruta y retraso de llegada promedio por grupo de distancia.
output:
SELECT RU.DistanceGroup, AVG(RU.Distance) AS DistanciaProm, AVG(DR.ArrDelayMinutes) AS RetrasoProm
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R
JOIN PROGRAMACION P ON R.ID_Programacion = P.ID_Programacion
JOIN RUTA RU        ON P.RutaID          = RU.RutaID
GROUP BY RU.DistanceGroup
ORDER BY RU.DistanceGroup;

instruction: Retraso de salida promedio para rutas con distancia mayor a 1000 millas.
output:
SELECT AVG(DR.DepDelayMinutes) AS RetrasoSalidaProm
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R
JOIN PROGRAMACION P ON R.ID_Programacion = P.ID_Programacion
JOIN RUTA RU        ON P.RutaID          = RU.RutaID
WHERE RU.Distance > 1000;

instruction: Numero de vuelos retrasados 15+ minutos por grupo de distancia.
output:
SELECT RU.DistanceGroup, SUM(CAST(DR.ArrDel15 AS INT)) AS VuelosRetrasados
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R
JOIN PROGRAMACION P ON R.ID_Programacion = P.ID_Programacion
JOIN RUTA RU        ON P.RutaID          = RU.RutaID
GROUP BY RU.DistanceGroup
ORDER BY RU.DistanceGroup;

instruction: Cual es el retraso de llegada promedio por trimestre del calendario de programacion?
output:
SELECT P.Quarter, AVG(DR.ArrDelayMinutes) AS RetrasoProm
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R
JOIN PROGRAMACION P ON R.ID_Programacion = P.ID_Programacion
JOIN RUTA RU        ON P.RutaID          = RU.RutaID
GROUP BY P.Quarter
ORDER BY P.Quarter;

instruction: Retraso de llegada promedio por dia de la semana segun la programacion.
output:
SELECT P.DayOfWeek, AVG(DR.ArrDelayMinutes) AS RetrasoProm
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R
JOIN PROGRAMACION P ON R.ID_Programacion = P.ID_Programacion
JOIN RUTA RU        ON P.RutaID          = RU.RutaID
GROUP BY P.DayOfWeek
ORDER BY P.DayOfWeek;

instruction: Compara el tiempo programado (CRSElapsedTime) con el retraso de llegada promedio por grupo de distancia.
output:
SELECT RU.DistanceGroup, AVG(P.CRSElapsedTime) AS TiempoProgramado, AVG(DR.ArrDelayMinutes) AS RetrasoProm
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R
JOIN PROGRAMACION P ON R.ID_Programacion = P.ID_Programacion
JOIN RUTA RU        ON P.RutaID          = RU.RutaID
GROUP BY RU.DistanceGroup
ORDER BY RU.DistanceGroup;

instruction: Top 10 rutas por numero de vuelos junto con su retraso de llegada promedio.
output:
SELECT TOP 10 RU.RutaID, COUNT(*) AS NumVuelos, AVG(DR.ArrDelayMinutes) AS RetrasoProm
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R
JOIN PROGRAMACION P ON R.ID_Programacion = P.ID_Programacion
JOIN RUTA RU        ON P.RutaID          = RU.RutaID
GROUP BY RU.RutaID
ORDER BY NumVuelos DESC;

instruction: Retraso por clima promedio en rutas cortas (DistanceGroup = 1).
output:
SELECT AVG(DR.WeatherDelay) AS WeatherDelayProm
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R
JOIN PROGRAMACION P ON R.ID_Programacion = P.ID_Programacion
JOIN RUTA RU        ON P.RutaID          = RU.RutaID
WHERE RU.DistanceGroup = 1;

instruction: Promedio de retraso de llegada por anio y trimestre de la programacion.
output:
SELECT P.Year, P.Quarter, AVG(DR.ArrDelayMinutes) AS RetrasoProm
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R
JOIN PROGRAMACION P ON R.ID_Programacion = P.ID_Programacion
JOIN RUTA RU        ON P.RutaID          = RU.RutaID
GROUP BY P.Year, P.Quarter
ORDER BY P.Year, P.Quarter;

instruction: Cuales son las rutas con distancia mayor a 2000 millas y su retraso de salida promedio?
output:
SELECT RU.RutaID, RU.Distance, AVG(DR.DepDelayMinutes) AS RetrasoSalidaProm
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R
JOIN PROGRAMACION P ON R.ID_Programacion = P.ID_Programacion
JOIN RUTA RU        ON P.RutaID          = RU.RutaID
WHERE RU.Distance > 2000
GROUP BY RU.RutaID, RU.Distance
ORDER BY RU.Distance DESC;

instruction: Cual es el tiempo de taxi out promedio de todos los vuelos?
output:
SELECT AVG(TX.TaxiOut) AS TaxiOutPromedio
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR    = CR.ID_CR
JOIN TAXI TX             ON CR.ID_TAXI = TX.ID_TAXI;

instruction: Cual es el tiempo de taxi in promedio?
output:
SELECT AVG(TX.TaxiIn) AS TaxiInPromedio
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR    = CR.ID_CR
JOIN TAXI TX             ON CR.ID_TAXI = TX.ID_TAXI;

instruction: Top 10 vuelos con mayor tiempo de taxi out.
output:
SELECT TOP 10 V.ID_Vuelo, V.Flight_Number_Operating_Airline, TX.TaxiOut
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR    = CR.ID_CR
JOIN TAXI TX             ON CR.ID_TAXI = TX.ID_TAXI
ORDER BY TX.TaxiOut DESC;

instruction: Suma del tiempo total de taxi (taxi out mas taxi in) de todos los vuelos.
output:
SELECT SUM(TX.TaxiOut + TX.TaxiIn) AS TaxiTotal
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR    = CR.ID_CR
JOIN TAXI TX             ON CR.ID_TAXI = TX.ID_TAXI;

instruction: Cuantos vuelos tuvieron un taxi out mayor a 30 minutos?
output:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS VuelosTaxiLargo
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR    = CR.ID_CR
JOIN TAXI TX             ON CR.ID_TAXI = TX.ID_TAXI
WHERE TX.TaxiOut > 30;

instruction: Taxi out promedio por aeropuerto de origen.
output:
SELECT V.OriginAirportID, AVG(TX.TaxiOut) AS TaxiOutProm
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR    = CR.ID_CR
JOIN TAXI TX             ON CR.ID_TAXI = TX.ID_TAXI
GROUP BY V.OriginAirportID
ORDER BY TaxiOutProm DESC;

instruction: Tiempo de taxi out promedio por mes.
output:
SELECT MONTH(V.FlightDate) AS Mes, AVG(TX.TaxiOut) AS TaxiOutProm
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR    = CR.ID_CR
JOIN TAXI TX             ON CR.ID_TAXI = TX.ID_TAXI
GROUP BY MONTH(V.FlightDate)
ORDER BY Mes;

instruction: Maximo y minimo de taxi in registrados.
output:
SELECT MAX(TX.TaxiIn) AS MaxTaxiIn, MIN(TX.TaxiIn) AS MinTaxiIn
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR    = CR.ID_CR
JOIN TAXI TX             ON CR.ID_TAXI = TX.ID_TAXI;

instruction: Promedio de taxi out junto al conteo de vuelos con WheelsOff registrado.
output:
SELECT AVG(TX.TaxiOut) AS TaxiOutProm, COUNT(CR.WheelsOff) AS VuelosConWheelsOff
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR    = CR.ID_CR
JOIN TAXI TX             ON CR.ID_TAXI = TX.ID_TAXI;

instruction: Dame los vuelos cuyo taxi in supera el taxi out.
output:
SELECT V.ID_Vuelo, TX.TaxiOut, TX.TaxiIn
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR    = CR.ID_CR
JOIN TAXI TX             ON CR.ID_TAXI = TX.ID_TAXI
WHERE TX.TaxiIn > TX.TaxiOut
ORDER BY TX.TaxiIn DESC;

instruction: Taxi out promedio por aeropuerto de origen, solo los 5 mas altos.
output:
SELECT TOP 5 V.OriginAirportID, AVG(TX.TaxiOut) AS TaxiOutProm
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR    = CR.ID_CR
JOIN TAXI TX             ON CR.ID_TAXI = TX.ID_TAXI
GROUP BY V.OriginAirportID
ORDER BY TaxiOutProm DESC;

instruction: Cuenta de vuelos por rango de taxi out (menos de 15, 15 a 30, mas de 30).
output:
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN TX.TaxiOut < 15 THEN 'Menos de 15'
        WHEN TX.TaxiOut BETWEEN 15 AND 30 THEN '15 a 30'
        ELSE 'Mas de 30'
    END AS RangoTaxiOut,
    COUNT(*) AS NumVuelos
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR    = CR.ID_CR
JOIN TAXI TX             ON CR.ID_TAXI = TX.ID_TAXI
GROUP BY CASE
        WHEN TX.TaxiOut < 15 THEN 'Menos de 15'
        WHEN TX.TaxiOut BETWEEN 15 AND 30 THEN '15 a 30'
        ELSE 'Mas de 30'
    END;

instruction: Cuantos vuelos opero cada aerolinea?
output:
SELECT AL.Operating_Airline, COUNT(*) AS NumVuelos
FROM VUELO V
JOIN AERONAVE AN  ON V.Tail_Number               = AN.Tail_Number
JOIN AEROLINEA AL ON AN.DOT_ID_Operating_Airline = AL.DOT_ID_Operating_Airline
GROUP BY AL.Operating_Airline
ORDER BY NumVuelos DESC;

instruction: Lista las aerolineas y su codigo IATA.
output:
SELECT DISTINCT AL.Operating_Airline, AL.IATA_Code_Operating_Airline
FROM VUELO V
JOIN AERONAVE AN  ON V.Tail_Number               = AN.Tail_Number
JOIN AEROLINEA AL ON AN.DOT_ID_Operating_Airline = AL.DOT_ID_Operating_Airline
ORDER BY AL.Operating_Airline;

instruction: Top 5 aerolineas con mas vuelos operados.
output:
SELECT TOP 5 AL.Operating_Airline, COUNT(*) AS NumVuelos
FROM VUELO V
JOIN AERONAVE AN  ON V.Tail_Number               = AN.Tail_Number
JOIN AEROLINEA AL ON AN.DOT_ID_Operating_Airline = AL.DOT_ID_Operating_Airline
GROUP BY AL.Operating_Airline
ORDER BY NumVuelos DESC;

instruction: Cuantas aeronaves distintas tiene cada aerolinea en los vuelos registrados?
output:
SELECT AL.Operating_Airline, COUNT(DISTINCT V.Tail_Number) AS NumAeronaves
FROM VUELO V
JOIN AERONAVE AN  ON V.Tail_Number               = AN.Tail_Number
JOIN AEROLINEA AL ON AN.DOT_ID_Operating_Airline = AL.DOT_ID_Operating_Airline
GROUP BY AL.Operating_Airline
ORDER BY NumAeronaves DESC;

instruction: Cuantos vuelos opero la aerolinea con codigo IATA 'AA'?
output:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS NumVuelos
FROM VUELO V
JOIN AERONAVE AN  ON V.Tail_Number               = AN.Tail_Number
JOIN AEROLINEA AL ON AN.DOT_ID_Operating_Airline = AL.DOT_ID_Operating_Airline
WHERE AL.IATA_Code_Operating_Airline = 'AA';

instruction: Numero de vuelos por aerolinea y por mes.
output:
SELECT AL.Operating_Airline, MONTH(V.FlightDate) AS Mes, COUNT(*) AS NumVuelos
FROM VUELO V
JOIN AERONAVE AN  ON V.Tail_Number               = AN.Tail_Number
JOIN AEROLINEA AL ON AN.DOT_ID_Operating_Airline = AL.DOT_ID_Operating_Airline
GROUP BY AL.Operating_Airline, MONTH(V.FlightDate)
ORDER BY AL.Operating_Airline, Mes;

instruction: Que aerolineas operan codigos compartidos (branded code share partners)?
output:
SELECT DISTINCT AL.Operating_Airline, AL.Operated_or_Branded_Code_Share_Partners
FROM VUELO V
JOIN AERONAVE AN  ON V.Tail_Number               = AN.Tail_Number
JOIN AEROLINEA AL ON AN.DOT_ID_Operating_Airline = AL.DOT_ID_Operating_Airline
WHERE AL.Operated_or_Branded_Code_Share_Partners IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY AL.Operating_Airline;

instruction: Cual es el retraso de llegada promedio por aerolinea?
output:
SELECT AL.Operating_Airline, AVG(DR.ArrDelayMinutes) AS RetrasoProm
FROM VUELO V
JOIN AERONAVE AN  ON V.Tail_Number               = AN.Tail_Number
JOIN AEROLINEA AL ON AN.DOT_ID_Operating_Airline = AL.DOT_ID_Operating_Airline
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R
GROUP BY AL.Operating_Airline
ORDER BY RetrasoProm DESC;

instruction: Top 5 aerolineas con mayor retraso de salida promedio.
output:
SELECT TOP 5 AL.Operating_Airline, AVG(DR.DepDelayMinutes) AS RetrasoSalidaProm
FROM VUELO V
JOIN AERONAVE AN  ON V.Tail_Number               = AN.Tail_Number
JOIN AEROLINEA AL ON AN.DOT_ID_Operating_Airline = AL.DOT_ID_Operating_Airline
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R
GROUP BY AL.Operating_Airline
ORDER BY RetrasoSalidaProm DESC;

instruction: Que modelos de avion y fabricantes opera cada aerolinea?
output:
SELECT DISTINCT AL.Operating_Airline, MA.Manufacturer, MA.Model
FROM VUELO V
JOIN AERONAVE AN        ON V.Tail_Number               = AN.Tail_Number
JOIN AEROLINEA AL       ON AN.DOT_ID_Operating_Airline = AL.DOT_ID_Operating_Airline
JOIN MODELO_DE_AVION MA ON AN.ID_Modelo                = MA.ID_Modelo
ORDER BY AL.Operating_Airline, MA.Manufacturer, MA.Model;

instruction: Cuantos vuelos opero cada fabricante de avion (Boeing, Airbus, etc.)?

FROM VUELO V

JOIN MODELO_DE_AVION MA ON AN.ID_Modelo  = MA.ID_Modelo
GROUP BY MA.Manufacturer
ORDER BY NumVuelos DESC;

instruction: Para cada aerolinea, dame su retraso de llegada promedio y su ranking de mejor a peor.
output:
SELECT
    AL.Operating_Airline,
    AVG(DR.ArrDelayMinutes) AS RetrasoProm,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(DR.ArrDelayMinutes) ASC) AS Ranking
FROM VUELO V
JOIN AERONAVE AN  ON V.Tail_Number               = AN.Tail_Number
JOIN AEROLINEA AL ON AN.DOT_ID_Operating_Airline = AL.DOT_ID_Operating_Airline
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R

    DR.ArrDelayMinutes,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY AL.Operating_Airline ORDER BY DR.ArrDelayMinutes DESC) AS NumFila

JOIN AEROLINEA AL ON AN.DOT_ID_Operating_Airline = AL.DOT_ID_Operating_Airline

instruction: Top 3 vuelos con mayor retraso por cada continente de destino usando una window function.
output:
WITH Ranked AS (
    SELECT
        V.ID_Vuelo,
        C.Nombre_Continente,
        DR.ArrDelayMinutes,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY C.Nombre_Continente ORDER BY DR.ArrDelayMinutes DESC) AS rk
    FROM VUELO V
    JOIN AEROPUERTO AD ON V.DestAirportID     = AD.AirportID
    JOIN CIUDAD CI     ON AD.CityMarketID     = CI.CityMarketID
    JOIN ESTADO E      ON CI.ID_Estado        = E.ID_Estado
    JOIN WAC W         ON E.WAC_ID            = W.WAC_ID
    JOIN CONTINENTE C  ON W.Nombre_Continente = C.Nombre_Continente
    JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
    JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
    JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R
)
SELECT Nombre_Continente, ID_Vuelo, ArrDelayMinutes
FROM Ranked
WHERE rk <= 3
ORDER BY Nombre_Continente, ArrDelayMinutes DESC;

instruction: Calcula el total acumulado de emisiones de CO2 por fecha de vuelo.
output:
SELECT
    V.FlightDate,
    SUM(R.co2) AS CO2Dia,
    SUM(SUM(R.co2)) OVER (ORDER BY V.FlightDate ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS CO2Acumulado
FROM VUELO V
JOIN RESULTADO R ON V.ID_Vuelo = R.ID_Vuelo
GROUP BY V.FlightDate
ORDER BY V.FlightDate;

instruction: Para cada mes, muestra el numero de vuelos y la diferencia respecto al mes anterior.
output:
SELECT
    MONTH(V.FlightDate) AS Mes,
    COUNT(*) AS NumVuelos,
    COUNT(*) - LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY MONTH(V.FlightDate)) AS DiffMesAnterior
FROM VUELO V
GROUP BY MONTH(V.FlightDate)
ORDER BY Mes;

    NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY AVG(DR.ArrDelayMinutes)) AS Cuartil
FROM VUELO V
JOIN AERONAVE AN  ON V.Tail_Number               = AN.Tail_Number
JOIN AEROLINEA AL ON AN.DOT_ID_Operating_Airline = AL.DOT_ID_Operating_Airline
JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R
GROUP BY AL.Operating_Airline;

instruction: Usando dos CTEs, compara el retraso promedio de salida y de llegada por grupo de distancia.

WITH Salidas AS (

    FROM VUELO V
    JOIN RESULTADO R         ON V.ID_Vuelo      = R.ID_Vuelo
    JOIN CRONOMETRIA_REAL CR ON R.ID_CR         = CR.ID_CR
    JOIN DETALLE_RETRASOS DR ON CR.ID_Detalle_R = DR.ID_Detalle_R
    JOIN PROGRAMACION P ON R.ID_Programacion = P.ID_Programacion

    GROUP BY RU.DistanceGroup

    GROUP BY RU.DistanceGroup
